## Objective

Implement a genuine production identity and session boundary inside existing crm-api and governed RequestAuthenticator, with durable actor/tenant access and a production-built browser client. Partial browser changes do NOT constitute G1 acceptance.

## Deliverables

- `reuse crm-capability-ingress RequestAuthenticator and ADR-029 with one OIDC Authorization Code PKCE backend flow, no second auth engine or microservice`
- `production built browser obtains only same-origin server-attested actor tenant capability CSRF expiry, never a bootstrap bearer in JS`
- `durable session actor tenant membership and live permissions through existing governed ingress and PostgreSQL tenant isolation`
- `server owned login callback logout refresh revocation expiry and restart semantics with trusted origin OIDC keys cookies and CSRF`
- `first admin explicitly provisioned server-side; no browser bootstrap credential or client actor escalation`
- `production web and crm-api integration tests: two users two tenants forged session replay expiry revocation restart and security negatives`
- `preserve Step22H accepted inventory ledger, zero new owner crates and zero generic business router switches`
- `regenerate active packet from exact G1 baseline; run full applicable CI`
